name: eden-ai
label: Eden AI
description: Eden AI is a platform that provides a range of AI services, including text generation, summarization, translation, and more.

apiKey.label: Eden AI API Key
apiKey.description: You can obtain your API key from your [Eden AI dashboard](https://app.edenai.run/admin/api-settings/features-preferences).

generate_text.label: Generate Text
generate_text.description: Generate text completions using various AI providers through Eden AI chat endpoint.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: The AI provider to use for text generation.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: The main prompt or question you want the AI to respond to.

system_prompt.label: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: System message to set the behavior and context for the AI assistant (e.g., "You are a helpful coding assistant").

model.label: Model
model.description: Specific model to use (e.g., gpt-4o, claude-3-sonnet-latest, gemini-2.0-flash). Leave empty for provider-specific defaults.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: Controls randomness (0.0-2.0). Higher values make output more creative.

max_completion_tokens.label: Max Completion Tokens
max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

reasoning_effort.label: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.description: Level of reasoning depth for the response.

fallback_providers.label: Fallback Providers
fallback_providers.description: Alternative providers to try if the main provider fails. A JSON list of: openai, anthropic, google, meta, mistral, cohere, xai, amazon, microsoft, deepseek, groq.

include_image.label: Include Image
include_image.description: Include an image in your prompt (for vision-capable models).

image_url.label: Image URL
image_url.description: URL of the image to include in the prompt (only used if "Include Image" is enabled).

summarize_text.label: Summarize Text
summarize_text.description: Extract key sentences and create summaries from long text passages using various AI providers.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: The AI provider to use for text summarization.

text.label: Text to Summarize
text.description: The text content you want to summarize. Can be articles, documents, or any long-form text.

output_sentences.label: Number of Summary Sentences
output_sentences.description: How many sentences should the summary contain (1-20).

language.label: Text Language
language.description: The language of the input text. Choose "Auto Detection" if unsure.

model.label: Specific Model
model.description: Specific model to use (e.g., gpt-4, gpt-4o, summarize-xlarge). Leave empty for default.

fallback_providers.label: Fallback Providers
fallback_providers.description: Alternative providers to try if the main provider fails (up to 5). A JSON list of: openai, microsoft, cohere, xai, anthropic, alephalpha, writesonic, meaningcloud, emvista, oneai.

show_original_response.label: Include Original Response
show_original_response.description: Include the raw provider response in the output for debugging.

extract_keywords.label: Extract Keywords in Text
extract_keywords.description: Identify important terms in a text using Eden AI. Supports multiple providers, languages, and models.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: The AI provider to use for keyword extraction.

text.label: Text to Analyze
text.description: The text to extract keywords from.

language.label: Text Language
language.description: The language of the input text. Choose "Auto Detection" if unsure.

model.label: Specific Model
model.description: Specific model to use (e.g., gpt-4o, gpt-4, grok-2-latest). Leave empty for default.

fallback_providers.label: Fallback Providers
fallback_providers.description: Alternative providers to try if the main provider fails (up to 5). A JSON list of: amazon, microsoft, openai, tenstorrent, xai, emvista, corticalio, oneai.

show_original_response.label: Include Original Response
show_original_response.description: Include the raw provider response in the output for debugging.

text.label: Text to Analyze

model.label: Specific Model

text.label: Prompt

text_to_speech.label: Generate Audio From Text
text_to_speech.description: Convert text to spoken audio using Eden AI. Supports multiple providers, languages, and voice customization.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: The AI provider to use for text-to-speech synthesis.

text.label: Text
text.description: The text to convert to speech.

language.label: Language
language.description: The language and locale for the speech synthesis (defaults to en-US if not specified).

option.label: Voice Gender
option.description: Choose the voice gender for speech synthesis (defaults to Female if not specified).

rate.label: Speaking Rate
rate.description: Adjust speaking rate (-100 to 100, where 0 is normal speed).

pitch.label: Voice Pitch
pitch.description: Adjust voice pitch (-100 to 100, where 0 is normal pitch).

volume.label: Audio Volume
volume.description: Adjust audio volume (-100 to 100, where 0 is normal volume).

audio_format.label: Audio Format
audio_format.description: The audio format for the generated speech (default: MP3).

sampling_rate.label: Sampling Rate
sampling_rate.description: Audio sampling rate in Hz (0-200000, 0 for provider default).

fallback_providers.label: Fallback Providers
fallback_providers.description: Alternative providers to try if the main provider fails (up to 5). A JSON list of: amazon, google, microsoft, lovoai, elevenlabs, openai, deepgram.

show_original_response.label: Include Original Response
show_original_response.description: Include the raw provider response in the output for debugging.
